title: Open a vault document in local ONLYOFFICE
description:
## Why
Agents need Word and the rest of the office suite inline so a person can see the edit. The BFF office bridge and `deploy/dev/lab-shared-compose-ds` already exist. The staging document server was Fargate and stays off.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`. Topology stays lab-shared-compose-ds (`docs/architecture/portal-document-server-topology.md`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Local Document Server starts from the lab compose
- [ ] The portal opens a docx from the local vault and shows the editor
- [ ] A save callback writes the bytes back to that vault file
- [ ] The staging-document-server Terraform module is not applied
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Local ONLYOFFICE opens a vault docx
- [ ] Save writes back to the vault
notes:
Lab Document Server from deploy/dev/lab-shared-compose-ds (docker compose up -d). Health http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthcheck returned true. DocsAPI loader served from /web-apps/apps/api/documents/api.js. .env copied from .env.example (lab JWT only, not committed). No terraform apply.

BFF env for the editor: BFF_OFFICE_VAULT_EDIT=true, BFF_OFFICE_JWT_SECRET matching the lab JWT, BFF_OFFICE_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=http://host.docker.internal:4000, BFF_OFFICE_DOCUMENT_SERVER_HOSTS=127.0.0.1,host.docker.internal,localhost. Vault file /notes/roundtrip.docx (fixture portal/packages/bff/fixtures/lab-office/roundtrip.docx).

Browser: signed in as dev@demo.local, opened notes/roundtrip.docx. ONLYOFFICE chrome mounted (File/Home menus, document surface). No error.

Save: POST status 2 to the minted callback with a changed docx hosted on 127.0.0.1. Response {"error":0,"code":"saved"}. Vault bytes matched the edited file (956 bytes). Brain RPC is off, so the callback writes through createFsOfficeCallbackVaultWriter under VAULT_ROOT. Test: portal/packages/bff/test/fs-callback-writer.test.ts.
close_reason: Local ONLYOFFICE opened a vault docx in the portal and a status-2 callback wrote the edited bytes back to that vault file. Staging document-server Terraform was not applied.

title: Let an agent install programs onto its persistent disk
description:
## Why
Plan 0008 keeps product CLIs prebaked in the snapshot and forbids install-on-boot. That still holds for the image. The user-facing computer also needs installs that survive idle: packages land on the persistent filesystem, not in a layer that disappears at stop.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An install requested by the agent writes onto the attached persistent disk
- [ ] After idle stop and wake, the installed program still runs
- [ ] Boot of a fresh sandbox does not apt-get or npm-install from the entrypoint
- [ ] Notes name the disk path and what is still image-only
design: Image stays prebaked (plan 0008 bucket A). User installs go to the R2-backed filesystem or a Daytona volume that is reattached on wake (bucket B). Do not expand the snapshot for one tenant's packages.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Install survives stop and wake
- [ ] Entrypoint still does not install on boot

title: Run agent-browser inside the Daytona sandbox and show the session
description:
## Why
The browser has to run on the agent's computer, which is the Daytona sandbox, and the user should see what it is doing.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`. Use the command shape from the local spike.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The sandbox image includes agent-browser and a Chrome build
- [ ] An agent tool call opens a URL and returns the snapshot text to the chat
- [ ] The portal shows a screenshot or the snapshot from that call
- [ ] The tool fails closed when the sandbox is stopped, then wakes and retries once
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Tool call returns a snapshot from the sandbox
- [ ] Portal shows the screenshot or snapshot
- [ ] Stopped sandbox wakes once and then runs the tool

title: Keep persistent memory and recent working memory across sandbox idle
description:
## Why
Agents already have MemPalace on the vault (`memory_read` / `memory_write`, palace dir under the vault). Working context lives in the external agent and disappears when the guest disk is gone. Persistent memory belongs on R2. Recent working memory needs an explicit restore on wake.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A memory_write survives sandbox stop and is returned by memory_read after the next wake
- [ ] A bounded recent-context record (the last turn summary or transcript tail) is stored with the agent and reloaded into the next turn
- [ ] One persona's palace is not readable by another persona
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] MemPalace survives idle on R2
- [ ] Recent context reloads on the next turn
- [ ] Personas do not share palaces

title: Spike agent-browser on the local machine
description:
## Why
Computer use was never finished. The Vercel package is `agent-browser` (https://github.com/vercel-labs/agent-browser): a CLI that snapshots an accessibility tree and clicks refs. Learn that CLI before baking it into a Daytona image.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] agent-browser opens a page, snapshots interactive refs, and follows one ref on the developer machine
- [ ] Notes record the command shape an agent tool should call (open, snapshot -i, click, screenshot)
- [ ] No Daytona snapshot publish is required for this spike
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Local open, snapshot, and click succeed
- [ ] Notes record the tool command shape
notes:
agent-browser 0.39.1 on this machine (npm prefix ~/.local, node 22; package asks for node 24 and still ran). Chrome was already installed. No Daytona snapshot.

Session: AGENT_BROWSER_SESSION=lp-bhcg-13
Page: python http.server on 127.0.0.1:8765 serving a page with one link.

Command shape an agent tool should call:
  agent-browser open <url>
  agent-browser snapshot -i
  agent-browser click @eN
  agent-browser snapshot -i
  agent-browser screenshot <path>

Proof: snapshot -i listed link "Open the next page" [ref=e2]. click @e2 navigated to http://127.0.0.1:8765/done.html and the next snapshot showed heading "Clicked".
close_reason: Local agent-browser opened a page, snapshotted interactive ref e2, and click @e2 landed on the next page. Command shape is in the notes. No Daytona publish.

title: Run two personas on localhost with separate keys, crons, and memory
description:
## Why
The product is one always-on agent host with multiple bots. Mailbox and room epics (`lp-v62i`, `lp-8sh4`) stay open; this bead is the smaller localhost proof that two personas are actually separate.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Two agents exist on one local tenant
- [ ] Each agent stores its own model base URL and API key
- [ ] Each agent has its own scheduled-task list
- [ ] Each agent has its own memory files, and a write from one does not appear in the other
- [ ] Switching agents in the portal shows the matching list
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Two agents, two keys, two cron lists, two memory files
- [ ] Portal switch shows the matching list
notes:
Two personas on one local tenant, each with its own key, cron list, and memory files.

Store: VAULT_ROOT/agents/<agent_id>/{backend.json,cron/jobs.json,memory/*}. GET /api/agents/:id/backend returns base_url, protocol, and api_key_last4, not the key. PUT /api/agents/:id/crons writes that agent's jobs and binds a scheduled-task thread namespaced by agent id. PUT /api/agents/:id/memory/:name writes only that agent's memory directory.

Chat uses the stored backend for the thread's agent ahead of the process AGENT_BACKEND_* fallback.

Proof 2026-10-15: created Alpha and Beta on the demo tenant. Alpha's openai_chat endpoint was 127.0.0.1:9101 with sk-alpha-key; Beta's was 127.0.0.1:9102 with sk-beta-key. Sends returned "alpha:-key:whoami" and "beta:-key:whoami". Cron lists were "Alpha digest" and "Beta digest". Memory notes.md was "alpha remembers the harbor" vs "beta remembers the ridge". In the portal, selecting Alpha showed only Alpha digest and notes.md; selecting Beta showed only Beta digest and notes.md.

Tests: portal/packages/bff/test/agent-persona-store.test.ts and portal/apps/web/src/features/projects/threadGroups.test.ts.
close_reason: Two localhost personas each have their own base URL, API key, cron list, and memory file. Switching agents in the portal shows the matching scheduled-task list and memory file.

title: Keep AWS staging parked while this revamp is the active path
description:
## Why
Open beads still describe live MockLab, relay DNS, EC2 dual-run, and Secrets Manager. They are real, and they are not how this restart proceeds. OPERATOR HOLD stays in force.

Plan: `docs/plans/0020-cloudflare-platform-revamp/overview.md`.

## Leave open, do not start next
`lp-v62i` mailbox live gate, `lp-k5c4` inbound spine leftovers, `lp-kng.6` vault remount proof, `lp-sjn9` and `lp-puzc` AWS latency, `lp-0pr` and `lp-3a1` EC2 dual-run, `lp-645` Secrets Manager, `lp-u00` EC2 decommission, `lp-2qs` admin on the live BFF.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] This bead's notes point at the epic as the active path
- [ ] No platform-staging terraform apply is performed
- [ ] Those open beads are not closed by this chore
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Notes point at this epic
- [ ] Listed AWS beads stay open
- [ ] Staging is not applied

title: Spine send remembers one harness turn three times
description:
## Why
On the localhost boot (lp-bhcg.1), one harness turn was opened three times on a single BFF events connection. The browser showed one assistant bubble; a curl SSE client received three `message_send` events for the same `turn_id`.

## What
`deliverSpineTurns` remembers the turn inside `processInboundRoom` and again after `waitForInboundItem`. `POST /chat/threads/:id/messages` then calls `harnessTurns.remember` again when `delivered.path === "harness"`. The events proxy enqueues on each remember. `claim` allows the same owner to reclaim a live claim, so the three notifications can all stream the turn.

## Acceptance
- [ ] One user send produces one harness `message_send` on one events connection
- [ ] Notes name the remember call sites that were collapsed

title: Remove the model selector from chat
description:
## Why
People should not choose a model. The composer selector (`ModelIntelligenceSelector` in `ChatView`, tiers Auto / Simple / Moderate / Complex) is the wrong surface for members and for admins. This covers hiding the selector from every user and taking it off the chat.

## What
Remove the model selector from the agent chat composer for every role. Do not leave a member-only hidden control. Admin model access is `lp-bhcg.21`, not a control in the transcript.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The chat composer has no model or intelligence selector for any role
- [ ] A signed-in member cannot choose a model per message
- [ ] Admins do not pick a model inside the chat either
- [ ] Model configuration, if shown, is only on an admin settings surface
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] The chat composer has no model or intelligence selector for any role
- [ ] A signed-in member cannot choose a model per message
- [ ] Admins do not pick a model inside the chat either
- [ ] Model configuration, if shown, is only on an admin settings surface
close_reason: Chat composer no longer renders ModelIntelligenceSelector and does not send a user-chosen model. Model configuration is the admin catalog on Settings. Acceptance: no selector for any role; members and admins cannot pick a model per message; catalog is settings-only. Browser on :3010 showed no model control. ChatView tests passed. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Let an admin set the model catalog and route with LiteLLM
description:
## Why
Model choice is an admin decision. After the chat selector is gone (`lp-bhcg.20`), the admin sets which models the tenant can use. Routing uses the LiteLLM path already sketched in `portal/apps/web/src/features/chat/modelIntelligence.ts` and ADR 0007. Plan 0020 said tier routing could wait. This bead brings it forward, still without a per-message picker.

## What
Admin settings list the models that tenant may call. Chat sends do not include a user-selected model. The server routes with LiteLLM (auto / simple / moderate / complex) inside that catalog.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] An admin can set which models that tenant may use
- [ ] A member has no model picker
- [ ] A chat turn is routed by the existing LiteLLM tier path, not by a person picking a model name
- [ ] A model outside the admin catalog is not called
close_reason: Admin GET/PUT /api/settings/model-catalog is isTenantAdmin-only and stored at VAULT_ROOT/admin/model-catalog.json. Chat routes by length to the enabled tier id (lanyard-simple under 80, lanyard-moderate under 400, otherwise lanyard-complex) and fails closed with 'No model is available' without calling the backend. This is the local stand-in for the LiteLLM tier names; no LiteLLM cloud or AWS call. Browser: short turn posted lanyard-simple, 420-char turn posted lanyard-complex, empty catalog returned the error, then the catalog was re-enabled. model-catalog.test.ts 4 passed. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Make agent chat a continuous bubble thread
description:
## Why
Agent chat should feel like texting a person, using the Meta Astryx ghost treatment already in the portal (`@astryxdesign`, ghost variants, `ChatMessageBubble`). Today the assistant footer in `ChatTimeline` shows the model name plus Copy and Regenerate (`chat-assistant-footer`). Channels already hide that chrome. 1:1 agent chat should too.

## What
Render the agent thread as bubbles. Keep a timestamp. Remove the model label, the Copy button, and Regenerate from assistant responses. Do not add a new visual theme.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] User and assistant turns render as chat bubbles on the Astryx ghost treatment
- [ ] A sent message can show the time it was sent
- [ ] The assistant footer does not show a model name
- [ ] Copy and Regenerate are not on assistant responses
- [ ] The thread reads as one continuous conversation
close_reason: User and assistant turns use filled ChatMessageBubble with a time and no model label, Copy, or Regenerate. ChatTimeline 44 passed and ChatView 49 passed. Browser thread showed timestamps on bubbles and no those actions. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Remove Halt from the agent chat header
description:
## Why
The top-right Halt control (`HaltRoomButton`, test id `mailbox-halt`, wired from `ChatView`) does not belong on the agent chat. The thread should stay a simple conversation.

## What
Remove the Halt button from the agent chat header. Do not rename it to Stop. Leave the halt HTTP route in place unless a later bead deletes the protocol.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The agent chat header has no Halt button
- [ ] mailbox-halt is not rendered on the agents chat page
- [ ] The mailbox halt API can stay; this bead is the header control
close_reason: HaltRoomButton is not mounted on the agents chat header. The halt HTTP route is unchanged. HaltRoomButton tests passed. Browser header had no Halt. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Drop the memory section from the agent side nav
description:
## Why
The left panel should list agents, channels, and scheduled tasks. `lp-bhcg.3` added `AgentMemoryList` under the side nav so a persona's memory files showed while that agent was selected. That section should not be on the panel.

## What
Remove the memory section from `ChatHistorySideNav`. Do not replace it with another memory browser in the side nav. Stored memory files can stay for the agent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The chat side nav has Channels, Agents, and Scheduled Tasks only
- [ ] No Memory heading or memory file list is rendered
- [ ] Per-agent memory files may remain on disk; they are not a side-nav section
close_reason: AgentMemoryList is gone. Side nav is Channels, Agents, and Scheduled Tasks. Memory files and BFF memory routes stay. ChatHistorySideNav 30 passed. Browser side nav had those three groups only. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Remove Brain wording from the portal
description:
## Why
Brain RPC is a host protocol name, and it is leaking into the product. The vault banner title is "Vault is local/fixture — not host Brain RPC" (`honestyCopy.ts`). Connectors has a section titled "On this brain". BFF responses say "Brain RPC host error" and "Brain RPC is disabled". Those strings are not useful to a person. They are leftover host-protocol copy, not a product concept.

## What
Replace user-visible Brain copy with plain language about files, settings, or the agent. Do not rename the internal Brain RPC methods in this bead. Empty states may stay short. Do not explain the old host protocol in the UI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A signed-in person never sees Brain, Brain RPC, or On this brain
- [ ] The vault banner no longer says local/fixture or host Brain RPC
- [ ] Connectors no longer has an On this brain heading
- [ ] API errors returned to the portal say what failed in plain language
- [ ] Internal code comments and protocol names can stay
close_reason: User-facing Brain RPC errors, the composer placeholder, the vault notice, and the fixture skill display name no longer say Brain. Connectors has no On this brain heading. Protocol names and code comments stay. honestyCopy 35 and VaultView 25 passed. Browser vault and settings chrome had no Brain label. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Group connectors into Apps and Skills
description:
## Why
The connectors catalog is split across SaaS cards, skills, MCP, CLI, and "On this brain" (`ConnectorsPage`). That split does not match how the product should read. Two groups are enough: Apps and Skills.

## What
Present the catalog as Apps and Skills. Fold the current SaaS, MCP, and CLI rows into those two groups. Team and admin management move with `lp-bhcg.27` and are not a third catalog category.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The connectors catalog has two groups: Apps and Skills
- [ ] SaaS, MCP, CLI, and On this brain are not separate catalog sections
- [ ] Existing connect and disconnect actions still work for an app and a skill
close_reason: Connectors catalog is Apps (SaaS, unbound MCP, CLI) and Skills. Catalog/Team tabs and On this brain headings are gone. Connect and disconnect actions remain. ConnectorsPage 6 passed. Browser showed Apps and Skills. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Move Settings under the account menu
description:
## Why
The top nav tab is labeled Connectors (`PortalShell` tab value `settings`, label `Connectors`). The account hover card only offers Logout and Switch account. Admin management (the Team pane on the connectors page) should sit with Settings, not in the catalog.

## What
Rename that page to Settings. Remove it from the top tab list. Add Settings to the account chip hover menu. Admin-only management lives on Settings, not as a Catalog / Team switch on the connector list. Members still reach Settings for their apps and skills (`lp-bhcg.26`).

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The top nav has no Connectors tab
- [ ] Hovering the account chip shows Settings
- [ ] Settings opens the page that is today labeled Connectors
- [ ] Admin management is on Settings, visible to an admin, and is not a catalog pane
- [ ] A member does not see the admin management section
close_reason: Top nav is Agents and Vault. Account menu includes Settings. Admin management renders when the team payload is present (tenant admin) and is not a catalog tab. PortalShell 7, SettingsView 37, and App tests passed. Browser account menu opened Settings; the admin session saw the catalog. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.

title: Show the vault as the agent computer's files
description:
## Why
The vault banner tells operators the tree is a local fixture and not host Brain RPC. The vault is the file view of the agent computer. The computer is the Daytona sandbox that already idles and wakes. A live view of that machine, and a way to take it over, is not required for this pass. Check Daytona later only if a desktop is actually needed. Do not pick a second computer framework here.

## What
After `lp-bhcg.25` removes the Brain banner, the vault page should present files for the agent. Opening a vault file still works on localhost. No live VM iframe and no takeover button in this bead.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The vault page does not mention Brain, Brain RPC, fixture, or host protocol
- [ ] The page reads as the agent's files
- [ ] A file in the local vault still opens
- [ ] This bead does not add a live Daytona desktop or a takeover control
- [ ] Daytona remains the agent's computer; no second computer framework is introduced
close_reason: Vault reads as Agent files / the agent's files. No Brain, fixture, or host-protocol banner, and no Daytona desktop or takeover control. VaultView 25 passed. Browser vault showed Agent files and the local tree. PR: https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/741.
